items.title: Edward "Noon" Johnson Interview, 1960-05-28
items.q: I don't know if that was his right name or his comedian named Rafford Brown. Rafford Brown.

ctx.x: I may have heard of some of those but I don't remember, I never met them. I don't think I saw them. They were from local, from here in town or did they come from out of town?

They come from out of town. Well, there was a great dancer too. Jack Wiggins. Yeah, I think I've heard of him. And the fellow, I don't know if they ever met, he used to, he was going to have a contest with Wiggins dancing. I don't know if that was his right name or his comedian named Rafford Brown. Rafford Brown. Now he danced with skate on, he skates, danced bare feet, danced with shoes on, bucks, you know, and then tap. Well, he was the fellow who wanted to challenge Wiggins.
Did you ever do any night club work with your groups? That is, aside from the traveling around the hotels, did you ever work anything on Bourbon Street or any place in that kind of area?
